args.request: Recover Midnight Club 3 DUB Edition Remix native car files from the supplied PS2 ISO as with prior games. Implement bounded DAVE/Dave and cooked ISO extraction, preserve duplicate occurrences and original carriers/provenance, recover all nested members and documented vehicle namespaces, verify regenerated bytes and preserve existing work. Research sources and qualify unsupported PS2 conversion/runtime claims. Add screened optional Choice/Noul/Score inventory assessment, run representative/ambiguous/failing-case experiments and real checks. Native extraction scope; geometry/GLB conversion remains explicitly subsequent work.

--- a/research/README.md
+++ b/research/README.md
@@ -54,3 +54,9 @@
 - [Gran Turismo wheels](gran-turismo-wheels.md): native template recovery, corrected dimension interpretation, wheel textures, neutral assembly and safe editable upgrades.
 
 - [Redline library](redline-library.md): native static mesh/texture conversion, 128 independent editable imports, verification, semantic-filter experiments and source limits.
+
+## Midnight Club 3 Remix
+
+- [Format research](midnight-club-3-remix-formats.md): DAVE/Dave and Hash archive code, Xbox/plain-TEX leads, live TypeSafe contracts and conversion limits.
+- [Native extraction](midnight-club-3-remix-extraction.md): 94 retained vehicle carriers, 4,323 nested members, ordinal-preserving shared resources, independent byte/selection checks and advisory experiments.
+- Open: PS2 PCK geometry/PPF texture decoding, native part/wheel assembly, GLB and viewer/dealership import, complete runtime dependency closure and visual fidelity.
